subject: Score harmonization and candidate tie-break plan — Rivera (SWE)
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Hayes <sophie.hiring@talentpartners.co>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0000
Subject: Score harmonization for Alex Rivera — please submit + quick sync

Team —

Thanks again for taking the interviews with Alex (SWE candidate) yesterday. I collected the raw scorecards and there is a pretty wide spread on system design (5–8) and culture fit (3–7). Before we lock a pass/fail decision I want to do a quick harmonization so we have a defensible consensus.

Ask: please reply with a one-liner confirming your final numeric scores (tech, system design, culture, overall) and one short sentence on your top concern (if any). If you want to adjust after rereading notes, state the updated score with a short rationale.

If we still end up split after quick sync, I propose a 30-minute tiebreak with a senior SWE (suggested: Neha or Rishi) to focus on system design tradeoffs — Ava will coordinate scheduling.

Attachments: rivera_scorecard_Q3.pdf (application/pdf), panel_raw_notes_rivera.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Chen
Hiring Lead, Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks all for the quick turn. We have: Marissa 6/6/6 (overall 6), Logan 6/8/5 (6), Priyom 5/5/7 (5). Panel mean overall = 5.7. System design variance is the main outlier.

Decision: proceed with a short tiebreak focused on system design failure modes (option A). Logan will take the interviewer role for the tiebreak; Priyom, Marissa — please bring one targeted question each on consistency/invalidation and on latency tradeoffs. Sophie — please schedule Alex for Fri 9/10 13:00–13:30 PT (we'll keep the slot tight).

Action items:
- Sophie: send invite to Alex + Logan + Priyom + Marissa (13:00–13:30 PT Fri 9/10) and include the attached scorecards.
- Priyom: draft one question on cache invalidation semantics (share in thread) — due Thu 9/9 18:00 PT.
- Marissa: draft one question on latency/consistency tradeoffs — due Thu 9/9 18:00 PT.
- Logan: prepare quick rubric for the 30-min tiebreak (pass / conditional / fail) and share before the session.
- Ava: I'll own final hire recommendation based on the tiebreak outcome.

I'll upload post-call notes to the candidate record: https://hire.redwood.ai/candidates/12345 and will file a short decision summary in HR (JIRA: HR-4321).

Thanks — appreciate the rapid turnaround.
Ava
Hiring Lead, Engineering
